description: Make a product video, as the app's Product video does: the product alone on camera, doing what it does, with a voiceover, a voiceover over music or music alone, and no presenter, written from the product's page and the description. This spends the team's credits: the price quote_product_video gives for the same choices, refunded if the video fails. Answers an id at once: call get_product_video with it about once a minute until its status is ready or failed, which takes a few minutes.

captions.description: Captions of the voiceover, on screen, on by default where there is a voiceover. Music alone has none, so captions are off with it and true is refused.

credits.description: The credits quote_product_video gave for these choices; a different figure is refused.

description.description: Describe the video: where it happens, what the product does in it and the point it gets across. Left out, it is made from the product's page alone.

idempotency_key.description: Any string unique to this video. Calling again with the same key and the same arguments answers as the first call did and spends nothing more.

language.description: The language the voiceover is spoken in. Left out, the team's ad language. Hungarian and Japanese require quality best or priority.

photos.description: Photo links from read_product to film the product from, up to as many as its quality films from; more are refused with that number.

product.description: The product's id from read_product, or the product's link.

quality.description: fast, the default, uses Seedance 2.0 mini for trying ideas; best uses Wan 3.0 for the videos the team publishes; priority uses Wan 3.0 Prime, first in our line, at a higher price of its own, refused while it is not offered. seedance25 selects Seedance 2.5 explicitly, independent of the model used by best. Send these quality values, not model names.

resolution.description: The resolution it is filmed in, a higher one at a higher price: 480p or 720p for fast; up to 1080p for best, priority and seedance25 where their engine films it, one not offered being refused with the ones that are. Left out, 480p while the team's balance is its free videos, else 720p. quote_product_video says which.

seconds.description: The length: fast product videos are 15 seconds, best, priority and seedance25 ones 15 or 30 seconds.

size.description: The shape it is filmed in, 9:16 by default; one its quality does not film is refused with the ones it does.

sound.description: spoken, the default, a voiceover; spoken_music, a voiceover over music; or music, music alone.

video_style.description: casual (the default), professional or energetic: how the voiceover reads and how it is filmed.

name: make_product_video
title: Make a product video
